content.what_it_is: Commented MATLAB surface-plot script with editable output/depth directories, selected eta indices, and hour labels (L8-L21). It loads depth, derives geographic coordinates (L25-L33), loads each selected eta, masks locations with negative dep, plots stacked panels with first/subsequent color limits, and labels each panel from the parallel time cell array (L43-L78).
entities: output directory fdir defined at L9
depth directory depth_file_dir defined from fdir at L12
selected file vector nfile defined at L15
time-label cell array time defined at L18
depth matrix dep loaded at L26
matrix dimensions n and m defined at L27
grid spacings dx and dy defined at L30-L31
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L32-L33
figure dimensions wid and len defined at L37-L38
loop variable num defined at L43
formatted suffix fnum defined at L47
eta array defined at L50 and modified at L53
colorbar handle cbar defined at L74

params_defined.name: time
params_defined.range: one hour label per selected output

equations.ref: mask eta according to reference depth sign

calls: set at L39, L75, and L76
unresolved: Portability defect at L9-L12: the default fdir is a developer-specific absolute path, so both depth and eta reads fail elsewhere unless the user edits source values.
Cross-array shape assumption at L26-L33 and L50-L59: eta is masked with dep and plotted on dep-derived coordinates without checking matching dimensions.
The independent nfile and time arrays at L15 and L18 are jointly indexed at L47 and L61 without an equal-length check; changing only one can make time{num} out of range.
MATLAB pcolor at L59 ordinarily omits the final matrix row and column as colored faces; no compensation is present if full-grid coverage is intended.
